title: Real-valued first-coordinate slice
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $g\colon\{\pm1\}^{n+1}\to\{\pm1\}$, and fix a sign $b\in\{\pm1\}$. The real-valued function associated with the restriction of $g$ to inputs whose first coordinate is $b$ equals the first-coordinate slice of the real-valued function associated with $g$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function $g$ on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube
